name: API-Sports (Football)
description: API-Football v3 soccer data: leagues, standings, teams, fixtures, head-to-head results, player statistics and injuries. Free tier advertises 100 requests/day. Direct signup: https://dashboard.api-football.com/register . These tools use football routes; use the separate API-Sports Basketball, Baseball, Hockey, Rugby, MMA, Formula 1, or NFL & NCAA integrations for other sports. Odds and statistics do not place bets.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API-Sports Key
credential_fields.description: From your API-Sports dashboard at https://dashboard.api-sports.io. Free tier ~100 req/day. (If you subscribed via RapidAPI instead, the auth headers differ — use a RapidAPI-shaped integration.)

credential_fields.name: host
credential_fields.label: API host
credential_fields.description: API-Football v3 host, normally v3.football.api-sports.io. Keep this connection on the football API; use the dedicated per-sport catalog entries for other sports.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Account + subscription status — requests used today, plan limits, account active. Cheap health check; call to confirm the key works + you have quota.

tools.name: leagues
tools.description: Find leagues/competitions. Returns league id + name + country + seasons covered. Use to resolve 'Premier League' → league id (39) before standings/fixtures.

tools.name: standings
tools.description: Current league table for a season — rank, team, played, win/draw/loss, goals for/against, points, form (last-5 string like 'WWDLW'). The single best read for assessing team strength when reasoning about a fixture.

season.description: YYYY (the starting year of the season).

team.description: Optional — restrict to one team's standing row.

tools.name: teams
tools.description: Find teams. Returns team id + name + country + founded + venue. Use to resolve a team name to its id (needed for head_to_head + fixtures filters).

tools.name: team_statistics
tools.description: Aggregate season stats for one team in one league — form, win/draw/loss splits home vs away, goals scored/conceded by interval, clean sheets, biggest streaks. Deeper than the standings row for assessing a team's true level.

tools.name: fixtures
tools.description: Matches — past results + upcoming fixtures. Filter by league+season, team, date, or a from/to window. Use last=N for a team's recent results, next=N for its upcoming schedule. Each fixture carries status, score, venue, and (for finished) the result. Use to verify whether a market should be resolved + check outcomes.

last.description: N most recent finished fixtures (for the given team).

next.description: N upcoming fixtures (for the given team).

status.description: Filter by status code — NS (not started), FT (full time), LIVE, etc.

tools.name: head_to_head
tools.description: Historical head-to-head between two teams — every prior meeting with date, competition, and result. The core enrichment for a match market: who tends to win when these two play. Pass h2h as 'TEAMID1-TEAMID2' (ids from the teams tool).

h2h.description: Two team ids joined by a dash, e.g. '33-34'.

last.description: Limit to the N most recent meetings.

tools.name: players
tools.description: Player search + season statistics — appearances, goals, assists, cards, rating. Use to resolve a player name to an id and pull their form.

tools.name: injuries
tools.description: Injury + suspension list for a league/season/team/fixture. Material for a match market — a key player out shifts the fair probability the books may not have fully priced.
